run_gradio_demo: run the gradio interface to launch a StyleNeRF 3D image synthesis demo server
check_name_model_path: check the model name and resolve it to a pretrained pkl checkpoint file path
get_model_load_generator: get and load a pretrained StyleNeRF generator model from a pkl checkpoint file
get_camera_traj_trajectory: get the camera trajectory matrix from pitch, yaw, and fov parameters for rendering
f_synthesis_render_image: f_synthesis renders a 3D image from two latent seeds with style mixing and camera controls
